title: Tales Of The Pumpkin Rabbit
overview: On Halloween Night, 1979, Martin Paredes ("The Walten Files", "Boozoo's Ghosts") along with the MP Animation Studio released "The Mysterious House", a grim tale about two children stumbling onto an ominous house while trick-or-treating. The film terrified viewers as a surprisingly dark and impactful Stranger-Danger PSA showcasing the most cruel and vile side of humans.  Prepare yourself to dive into The Waterman House once more with "The Return of the Pumpkin Rabbit". The direct sequel, taking place 4 years after the somber ending of the first entry, follows Jay and her mischievous group of friends who decide to wander into the now abandoned Waterman House. Written and Produced by MP Studios, The film dives deeper into the twisted mind of the Pumpkin Rabbit and the Witch Sheep in an action-packed, tense and thrilling showdown!
